Flexibility and On-Premise Lose Support September 30, Two Weeks After This Issue Publishes

In this issue

  • What Agentic Ziggy Manages. Akeneo introduced Agentic Ziggy as the headline of the Summer Release, under the press release title Akeneo Introduces the First Truly Agentic Product Experience Platform.
  • The MCP Server's Real Scope. The MCP Server itself may not be brand new. The Winter Release language describes an expanded MCP Server alongside Digital Showroom and Custom Components, which implies an existing capability being built out further.
  • Where the Free Tier Runs Out. Each feature named above requires Akeneo's SaaS product line.
  • Where the Case Holds Up. Akeneo's advantage starts with what a PIM already does well, hold governed, enriched product data as a single source of truth.
  • Who it is for, and who it is not for. For teams running Akeneo's SaaS product on Growth or Enterprise edition, already paying for the platform and looking to put an agent interface in front of the PIM team or open the catalog to Stripe's checkout agents, this release cycle reads as shipped product.
  • The readiness score, and what it means here. My readiness score, and this one is scored on paper too.
